placements.title: Enforcing release verification and deployment gates across environments

placements.title: Mandatory signed release manifests gate deployments to prevent unverified artifacts
placements.frame: How do mandatory signed manifests and gate ownership protect staging and production against unverified deployment artifacts?
placements.why: Quinton mandates signed release manifests for all Meridian deployments across staging and production in response to past unsigned artifacts reaching staging.
